headline: Shalil S Shroff files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code for Punjab Chemicals & Crop Protection
sum: Shalil S Shroff has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Code, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares in Punjab Chemicals & Crop Protection Limited. The filing triggers mandatory public disclosure and potential open offer obligations under the 2011 Regulations.
detail: Shalil S Shroff, acting as acquirer, has submitted a statutory disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is mandated whenever a person crosses material shareholding thresholds (5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, etc.) in a listed company. The filing does not yet confirm the exact shareholding percentage, quantum of shares acquired, or consideration, but signals an active acquisition campaign. Depending on the final stake, an open offer (mandatory at 25%) or voluntary offer may follow. No legal advisers are named in the NSE disclosure document itself.
